# Shopify

> > Shopify is a comprehensive commerce platform providing ecommerce, point-of-sale (POS), B2B, and enterprise solutions with developer tools, payment processing, and headless commerce capabilities.

Shopify offers a full-stack commerce operating system spanning online stores, retail POS systems, B2B wholesale, and enterprise-grade Shopify Plus. The platform includes developer APIs, Shopify Functions for extensibility, Hydrogen for headless commerce, integrated payments, domain registration, and marketing automation through Shopify Messaging.

## Key Topics

- Shopify Plus (enterprise commerce)
- Shopify POS (point-of-sale systems)
- Shopify API & Shopify Functions
- Headless commerce & Hydrogen
- B2B commerce capabilities
- Shopify Payments
- ERP/OMS/CMS integrations
- Built for Shopify (app certification)
- Platform migration & comparisons
- Developer tools & extensibility
- Domain registration (Shopify Domains)
- Email & SMS marketing automation
- Customer experience optimization
- SSL & security

## Enterprise & Shopify Plus

- [Migrating to Shopify Plus](https://www.shopify.com/plus/migration): Enterprise migration service to Shopify Plus with launch engineer support
- [Integrate in minutes with Shopify Plus](https://www.shopify.com/plus/integrate): Shopify Plus API/SDK integration and automation with Shopify Flow
- [The Shopify B2B Demo Store](https://www.shopify.com/b2b-demo-store): Interactive B2B commerce demo showcasing Shopify Plus capabilities
- [Integrations for enterprise](https://www.shopify.com/developers/tools/integrations): Enterprise integration options and composable commerce architecture
